user.title: HomePower Battery Manager
user.description: After adding, open HomePower in the sidebar, or use Configure on this integration, to add batteries and schedules. HomePower connects to your batteries directly; no other integration is needed.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one HomePower instance is supported.

init.title: HomePower
init.description: Manage batteries and schedules here, or in the HomePower sidebar panel (/homepower) for the graphical view.

menu_options.control_battery: Allow / stop control of a battery
menu_options.add_goal: Add a goal (be at X% by a time)

add_battery.title: Add a battery
add_battery.description: HomePower connects to the battery directly. Pick the model next.

anker_find.title: Find the Anker battery
anker_find.description: Switch on Modbus TCP in the Anker app (device > Settings > Three-Party Control Settings). Scan result: {found}. {error}

ecoflow_account.title: EcoFlow account keys
ecoflow_account.description: Create an Access Key and Secret Key at developer.ecoflow.com with your EcoFlow account. HomePower then lists your batteries. {error}

battery_details.title: Connected: {readings}
battery_details.description: Everything the battery reports (capacity, power limits, minimum charge) is read from it directly. Only anything it can't report is asked for. New batteries are monitor-only: leave control off until the readings above look right, then turn it on here or later via Configure.

data.capacity_wh: Capacity (Wh) - the battery didn't report it
data.max_charge_w: Max charge (W) - the battery didn't report it
data.max_discharge_w: Max discharge (W) - the battery didn't report it
data.control_enabled: Let HomePower send commands to this battery

entity_details.title: Choose the entities
entity_details.description: For batteries without a built-in driver: pick the entities that read and control the battery.

data.invert_power: Power sensor reports discharging as positive (flip sign)

battery_modes.title: Mode names
battery_modes.description: Which option of the mode select does each role use?

control_battery.title: Allow control
control_battery.description: Monitor-only batteries are read and shown but never commanded.

add_schedule.title: Add a schedule
add_schedule.description: Leave batteries empty to apply to all. An end time earlier than the start runs overnight. Optionally only run while an entity (e.g. a cheap-rate sensor) is on.

data.name: Name
data.condition_entity: Only while this entity is on
data.all_day: Ignore times; follow the entity only

add_goal.title: Add a goal
add_goal.description: HomePower charges in the cheapest half-hours so the battery reaches the target by the deadline. Needs prices: set them in Settings.

data.name: Name
data.use_forecast: Charge less when tomorrow's solar forecast is good

modbus_map.title: Modbus device
modbus_map.description: Describe the registers as a small JSON map (see the README). Map: {preset}. {error}

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: The common settings. The HomePower panel has all of them, including protected loads.

data.peak_shaving: Peak shaving (discharge to stay under the import limit)
data.grid_import_entity: Smart meter import sensor (optional; power or energy counter)
data.offpeak_auto: Find the cheap/night period from the tariff's price history
data.storm_entity: Turn backup on while this is on

edit_schedule_form.title: Change schedule: {name}
edit_schedule_form.description: Anything not shown here (season, one-off date, priority, sharing a total) is kept as it is; the sidebar panel can change those.

data.condition_entity: Only while this entity is on
data.all_day: Ignore times; follow the entity only

abort.not_loaded: HomePower is not loaded yet; restart Home Assistant or check the log.

override.name: Manual override
override.description: Force a mode for a while, taking priority over schedules.

backup.name: Backup mode
backup.description: Keep a reserve for power cuts.

test_control.name: Test control
test_control.description: Send a tiny safe command and check the battery follows it.
